scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm

    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning... lines remaining: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(1)

# provides a method to retrieve that folder we use it; otherwise we fall
# back to searching the workspace directory for the newest image file.

    gallery_folder = os.getcwd()

        opmode.Mode = 2

    # fallback: set generic mode attribute if present
    if hasattr(opmode, 'Tapping'):
        opmode = opmode.Tapping

# Configure scan geometry (10 µm x 10 µm)
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6   # meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # meters
scan.Points = 128         # points per line

if not candidates:
    raise FileNotFoundError('No image file found after scan')
# Sort by modification time, newest first
candidates.sort(reverse=True)
image_path = candidates[0][1]
print('IMAGE_PATH:', image_path)

#imports 
import nanosurf

#load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
application = spm.application

#all variables
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

#Remove comments and update only requested parameters; leave other untouched.
# Set scan parameters

'''Python code to set Nanosurf AFM PID gains and scan parameters (gentle mode)'''
import nanosurf

# Initialize the AFM system (choose the appropriate class for your hardware)
spm = nanosurf.SPM()          # e.g., .C3000(), .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
app = spm.application

# Access relevant subsystems
scan = app.Scan               # Scan settings
zctrl = app.ZController       # Z‑controller (PID) settings

# ---- Scan parameters (minimize tip damage) ----
# Short line time and moderate number of lines reduce lateral forces
scan.Scantime = 0.1           # Time per line [s]
scan.Lines = 128              # Lines per frame

# (Optional: keep other scan geometry unchanged or set gentle defaults)
# scan.ImageWidth = 5e-6      # [m] – example width
# scan.ImageHeight = 5e-6     # [m] – example height
# scan.Points = 256           # Points per line (resolution)

# ---- PID controller gains (gentle feedback) ----
zctrl.PGain = 100             # Proportional gain
zctrl.IGain = 6000            # Integral gain
zctrl.DGain = 10              # Derivative gain

# (Optional: set set‑point or other Z‑controller parameters if needed)
# zctrl.SetPoint = 1.0        # Example set‑point [%/V]

# Clean up
del spm
